bugs.description: The inclusive loop executes maxAttempts plus one sends, violating the caller's configured attempt ceiling.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: Every send through the configured maximum fails.
bugs.observableImpact: The delivery performs an unauthorized extra external call and can exceed retry, latency, or rate-limit budgets.
bugs.provenance: Seeded loop-bound regression with an unchanged call-count test that passes at base and fails at head.
